key_insight: Lie-AS-ISC uses PDE Lie symmetries to guide adaptive sampling and improve physics-informed neural network accuracy.
engineering_relevance: The approach targets more accurate mesh-free PDE solvers for physics and engineering problems where uniform sampling misses complex solution features.
method: Use Lie symmetry transformations to derive solution–variable relationships and construct basis points with exact solutions.
Adapt training-point sampling using both absolute error and invariant surface conditions.
Introduce a dual-index loss to strengthen training constraints.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports consistently higher accuracy than existing methods in experiments, but provides no benchmark details or quantitative gains.
watch_item: Applicability depends on usable PDE Lie symmetries and the ability to construct the required exact-solution basis points.
paper_title: Lie Symmetry-Guided Adaptive Sampling for Physics-Informed Neural Networks
